# Settings

<!-- Generated by tools/Build-SettingsDoc.ps1 from core/settings.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every integration accepts the same settings and applies the same defaults. Only the spelling of
the name changes with the platform's convention. The step prints the effective value of every
setting at the start of each run (secrets are shown only as set or not set).

## Names on each platform

| Setting | GitHub Actions, CircleCI | Azure DevOps, Jenkins | GitLab | Environment variable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configuration-path | `configuration-path` | `configurationPath` | `configuration_path` | `DSCPR_CONFIGURATION_PATH` |
| configuration-repository-url | `configuration-repository-url` | `configurationRepositoryUrl` | `configuration_repository_url` | `DSCPR_CONFIGURATION_REPOSITORY_URL` |
| configuration-revision | `configuration-revision` | `configurationRevision` | `configuration_revision` | `DSCPR_CONFIGURATION_REVISION` |
| source-token (secret) | `source-token` (GitHub), `source-token-variable` (CircleCI) | `sourceToken` (Azure DevOps), `sourceTokenCredentialsId` (Jenkins) | CI/CD variable `DSCPR_SOURCE_TOKEN` | `DSCPR_SOURCE_TOKEN` |
| mode | `mode` | `mode` | `mode` | `DSCPR_MODE` |
| engine | `engine` | `engine` | `engine` | `DSCPR_ENGINE` |
| engine-version | `engine-version` | `engineVersion` | `engine_version` | `DSCPR_ENGINE_VERSION` |
| fail-on-error | `fail-on-error` | `failOnError` | `fail_on_error` | `DSCPR_FAIL_ON_ERROR` |
| report-path | `report-path` | `reportPath` | `report_path` | `DSCPR_REPORT_PATH` |
| connect | `connect` | `connect` | `connect` | `DSCPR_CONNECT` |
| azure-devops-organization | `azure-devops-organization` | `azureDevopsOrganization` | `azure_devops_organization` | `DSCPR_AZURE_DEVOPS_ORGANIZATION` |
| azure-devops-authentication | `azure-devops-authentication` | `azureDevopsAuthentication` | `azure_devops_authentication` | `DSCPR_AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTHENTICATION` |
| azure-devops-token (secret) | `azure-devops-token` (GitHub), `azure-devops-token-variable` (CircleCI) | `azureDevopsToken` (Azure DevOps), `azureDevopsTokenCredentialsId` (Jenkins) | CI/CD variable `DSCPR_AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN` | `DSCPR_AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN` |
| policy-path | `policy-path` | `policyPath` | `policy_path` | `DSCPR_POLICY_PATH` |
| require-policy | `require-policy` | `requirePolicy` | `require_policy` | `DSCPR_REQUIRE_POLICY` |

| module-source | `module-source` | `moduleSource` | `module_source` | `DSCPR_MODULE_SOURCE` |
| module-source-repository | `module-source-repository` | `moduleSourceRepository` | `module_source_repository` | `DSCPR_MODULE_SOURCE_REPOSITORY` |

| verbose | `verbose` | `verbose` | `verbose` | `DSCPR_VERBOSE` |

Secrets are never plain settings. Each platform takes them from its own secret store: a GitHub
secret, a secret pipeline variable in Azure DevOps, a masked CI/CD variable in GitLab, a context
variable in CircleCI, and a credentials ID in Jenkins.

## Configuration source

| Setting | Default | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `configuration-path` | (empty) | any | Directory that holds the Datum configuration (the folder containing Datum.yml), relative to the working directory. Set this or configuration-repository-url, not both. |
| `configuration-repository-url` | (empty) | any | HTTPS or SSH URL of a Git repository that holds the Datum configuration. The runner clones it. Set this or configuration-path, not both. Requires git on the agent. |
| `configuration-revision` | (empty) | any | Branch, tag or commit to check out when configuration-repository-url is set. A full 40-character commit SHA is verified after the clone and is the recommended value. |
| `source-token` (secret) | (empty) | any | Token used to clone configuration-repository-url over HTTPS when the repository is private. Needs read access to that repository only. Supply it from the platform's secret store. |

## Run

| Setting | Default | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `Test` | `Test`, `Set`, `DryRun` | Test reports drift and changes nothing. Set applies the configuration. DryRun validates the configuration without calling an engine, connecting to a target or reading a credential. |
| `engine` | `DscV2` | `DscV2`, `DscV3` | DscV2 uses Invoke-DscResource (PowerShell resources; most are Windows-only). DscV3 uses the dsc command-line engine, which must already be installed and on PATH. |
| `engine-version` | (empty) | any | Optional engine version passed to the runner (-EngineVersion). Leave empty for the engine's default. |
| `fail-on-error` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Fail the step when the run status is Failed or Aborted. In Test mode drift counts as a failure, so this makes a Test run a compliance gate. |
| `report-path` | `dsc-reports` | any | Directory for the reports (CSV and JSON per node, report.json, and this integration's result.json and outputs.env). Created if missing. Publish it as a build artifact. |

## Azure DevOps connection

| Setting | Default | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connect` | `None` | `None`, `AzureDevOps` | AzureDevOps opens an Azure DevOps session before the run, for configurations that manage Azure DevOps with AzureDevOpsDscNative. That module must be installed (list it in resource-modules). |
| `azure-devops-organization` | (empty) | any | Azure DevOps organization name. Required when connect is AzureDevOps. |
| `azure-devops-authentication` | `PAT` | `PAT`, `ManagedIdentity` | How to authenticate to Azure DevOps. PAT needs azure-devops-token. ManagedIdentity needs an agent that runs with an Azure managed identity. |
| `azure-devops-token` (secret) | (empty) | any | Azure DevOps personal access token (20 to 120 letters and digits). Required when connect is AzureDevOps, authentication is PAT and mode is not DryRun. Supply it from the platform's secret store. |

## Capability policy

| Setting | Default | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `policy-path` | (empty) | any | Preview. A capability policy file that says what each layer of the configuration may use, relative to the working directory. Usually not needed: a Policy.yml at the root of the configuration, beside Datum.yml, is used automatically. A file named here wins over it. Needs a Dsc.PipelineRunner release newer than 1.2.1. |
| `require-policy` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Preview. Fail the step when the configuration has no capability policy (no Policy.yml beside Datum.yml and no policy-path), so removing the policy cannot switch enforcement off unnoticed. Needs a Dsc.PipelineRunner release newer than 1.2.1. |

## Installation

| Setting | Default | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `module-version` | (empty) | any | Exact Dsc.PipelineRunner version to install, for example 1.2.1. Pinning is recommended. Empty uses a version already on the agent, otherwise installs the newest stable release. |
| `allow-prerelease` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Allow a preview version of Dsc.PipelineRunner (needed when module-version names one, for example 1.3.0-preview1). |
| `module-repository` | `PSGallery` | any | Registered PowerShell repository to install modules from. Use this for an internal feed; the repository must already be registered on the agent. |
| `module-source` | `Gallery` | `Gallery`, `Repository` | Where Dsc.PipelineRunner comes from. Gallery installs a published release (module-version, module-repository). Repository clones the module's source repository at module-source-ref, builds it on the agent and runs that build; use it to run an unreleased commit, a branch or a fork. Requires git. |
| `module-source-repository` | `https://github.com/ZanattaMichael/Dsc.PipelineRunner` | any | Git URL of the Dsc.PipelineRunner source repository, used when module-source is Repository. Point it at a fork or an internal mirror if you need to. Its build script runs on the agent, so use only a repository you trust. |
| `module-source-ref` | (empty) | any | Tag, branch or commit of the source repository to build. Required when module-source is Repository. A full 40-character commit SHA is verified after the clone and is the recommended value. |
| `resource-modules` | (empty) | any | DSC resource modules the configuration uses, one per line or comma-separated, as Name or Name@Version (for example PSDscResources@2.12.0.0). Pinning versions is recommended. |
| `skip-module-install` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Install nothing. Use on agents or container images where Dsc.PipelineRunner and the resource modules are already present, or where the agent has no access to a module repository. |

## Diagnostics

| Setting | Default | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keep-temporary-directory` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Keep the clone and the compiled per-node YAML on disk after the run, to debug a compile failure. |
| `verbose` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Write the runner's verbose log. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Overall run status: Completed, PartialSuccess, Failed or Aborted; or InvalidSettings when the settings were not valid and nothing ran. |
| `total-resources` | Number of resources evaluated. |
| `pass-count` | Number of resources that passed. |
| `fail-count` | Number of resources that failed (in Test mode this includes drift). |
| `skip-count` | Number of resources skipped. |
| `report-path` | Absolute path of the report directory. |
| `module-version` | The Dsc.PipelineRunner version that ran. |

How to read an output on each platform:

| Platform | How |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub Actions | `${{ steps.<id>.outputs.status }}` |
| Azure DevOps | `$(<stepName>.status)`; hyphens become underscores, for example `$(<stepName>.fail_count)` |
| GitLab | Later jobs receive `DSCPR_STATUS`, `DSCPR_FAIL_COUNT` and so on as variables (dotenv report) |
| CircleCI | Read `<report-path>/outputs.env` in a later step |
| Jenkins | The step returns a map: `result.status`, `result.failCount` and so on |
| Anything else | `<report-path>/outputs.env` (`DSCPR_STATUS=...`) and `<report-path>/result.json` |

The step also exits with a code: `0` success, `1` the run failed (or could not run), `2` the
settings are not valid.
